A portrait of a Sunset photographed at Dipor Bil, Guwahati
also spelt as Deepor Beel (Assamese: দীপৰ বিল) (bil or beel means "lake" in the local Assamese language), located south-west of Guwahati city, in Kamrup district of Assam, India. A permanent freshwater lake, in a channel of the Brahmaputra River.
Deepor beel is an avian wildlife protected area in Assam, India.
On the way to Deepor Beel, in Guwahati, Assam.
